resolution.note: node scripts/claude/successor-probe.ts creates a scratch shell tab (label successor-probe-shell) in the caller's workspace, types /bin/sh <scratch>/launch.sh into it to run the launcher with KRN_SUCCESSOR_AGENT=claude, --model haiku and an untrusted mkdtemp cwd, waits for the launcher's exit file, reads herdr agent get on the reported successor pane, and prints one verdict line (exit 0 only for launcher exit 0 and claude blocked). It closes the successor tab, then the shell tab, on every exit path including SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP: the reported ids plus every tab carrying a probe label in the workspace, never the caller's tab, so a killed probe's tabs close on the next run. test/claude/successor-probe.test.ts runs the real launcher through a sh stub serving verbatim Herdr 0.9.1 captures (9 new in test/fixtures/herdr) over 11 paths; mutants without the label sweep or the signal trap fail it. Live run from the lead pane: successor-probe: PASS; launcher exit 0; agent claude blocked; closed tabs w1D:tB3 w1D:tB2, exit 0 in 5 s, no probe tab or scratch cwd left, lead tab label unchanged.

title: Script the launcher's live Herdr probe
body:
Outcome: one command proves a successor-launch change against the real Herdr: it creates a scratch shell tab, runs scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts there with an untrusted scratch cwd (the successor holds on Claude's folder-trust dialog and spends no tokens), prints the launcher's stdout, stderr and exit plus the successor's `herdr agent get` status as one verdict line, and closes both tabs; it never runs the launcher from the caller's own pane.
Evidence: t-tdkpgag (#361), t-p4akh87 (#364) and t-g1cwxm2 (#369) each hand-built this probe from a task body (herdr tab create, pane run, a polling loop, two tab closes). Run from the lead's pane instead, the probe renames the lead's tab and the probe successor's --retire closes the lead pane once idle.
Proof: a test drives the probe's Herdr calls through a stub serving the verbatim captures in test/fixtures/herdr and asserts both tabs close on every exit path; one live run prints the verdict with `agent claude blocked`, exit 0, and leaves no probe tab.
